Staff only: the casino's back of house
Two to count · two to sign
Every night's drop boxes come here from the tables. Two clerks count every chip by colour, a second time to be sure, and both sign the sheet before it goes into the vault.
Every table, machine and door on the floor has a camera, and the screens here never sleep. When a big win comes up, or a dispute at a table, the officer pulls the recording for the pit boss.
Lockers for every post, the kettle, a sofa and the notice board: the rota, the house rules, and who has the next night off.
The manager's office
The casino manager's desk, the safe for the night's float, the books. Hiring, promotions and raises for the Hidden Crescent's staff are decided here.

Pass line: 7 or 11 on the first roll wins, 2, 3 or 12 loses; any other number is the point, and you win if it comes again before a 7. Don't pass is the reverse (12 on the first roll is a stand-off). The field , one roll: 3, 4, 9, 10 or 11 pay even money, 2 pays double, 12 pays triple. Any seven , one roll, pays 4 to 1.
